the contamination MODEL is a design choice, not a measured fact. 'foreign = record.tokens - task_context_tokens' encodes strict scoping: a record carrying ANY token outside the task context is dropped, even if it also carries a matching one. A recall-oriented reading (drop only when the intersection is empty) would keep those records. No corpus was measured to decide which reading loses less useful context — the strict reading was chosen because it is the safety direction and it is stated plainly in the docstring.

'untagged record passes the token axis' (empty record.tokens) is a deliberate semantic, not an empirical one. If real deposits are commonly untagged, this axis will be a no-op for them and the whole filter reduces to distance + decay for that population. Unmeasured.
